title: Ancestor

inlines.v: AN'CESTOR, noun [Latin antecessor, of ante, before, and cedo, to go.] One from whom a person descends, either by the father or mother, at any distance of time, in the tenth or hundredth generation. An ancestor precedes in the order of nature or blood; a predecessor, in the order of office.
